- Added _meta.json for skill metadata.

Initial release of holy-ceremony-transform-video-gen-seedance2-0:

- Launches a skill to generate sacred, celebratory video transformations in Seedance 2.0 style—featuring gold-white light, confetti, and dignified ceremony visuals.
- Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video, locked exclusively to the SEEDANCE_2_0 model.
- Requires prompt expansion for cinematic richness unless user opts out; confirms all final prompts with the user before submission.
- Enforces use of public HTTPS images, Node.js 18+, and WERYAI_API_KEY; no negative prompt or unsupported models allowed.
- Complete CLI and workflow instructions provided, ensuring at least one playable video link or a clear error is always returned.
